name: BEN_PRTL_MO_RT_PRTN_VAL_F
description: BEN_PRTL_MO_RT_PRTN_VAL_F identifies how to prorate rates , in those cases when a participant's enrollment coverage date falls within a month and the plan requires that  rates be prorated based upon the date during the month the participant's coverage started.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
